name: Web console
description: The Livy web UI (station wall, station pages, owner console) served from this node's own port. Boots even when the build is missing.
author: livy

settingsSchema.label: Mount path
settingsSchema.help: Where the console appears on this node. "/" is the root; "/console" keeps the root free for something else.

settingsSchema.label: Build directory
settingsSchema.help: Folder to serve, relative to the plugin (or an absolute path to a build you made elsewhere).
